what_it_does: Dashboard relationships from imported BI files: When you import a Power BI or Tableau file with Genie Code, migration tooling now creates dashboard relationships where it detects them in the source file. Customize date picker quick select options with Genie Code: You can now ask Genie Code for dashboard authoring to customize the quick select options in a date range picker filter, such as keeping only day based ranges. For an example prompt, see Optional: Customize the date picker quick select options with Genie Code.
why_it_matters: The check validates business definitions, grain, attribution, population, time window, units, scale, and category values to improve the accuracy and consistency of metrics.
